Interstate 676 in New Jersey between mile markers 2 and 4.

Jersey...and southeastern Pennsylvania.

properties.description:
...The Flood Advisory continues for the following rivers in Texas...

Los Olmos Creek Near Falfurrias affecting Brooks County.

steadily this afternoon, and is now expected to drop below action
stage early Friday morning. The latest forecast has gauge levels
falling well below bankfull over the weekend, and remaining so into
early next week.

For the Los Olmos Creek...including Falfurrias...elevated river
levels are forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues along
the creek banks.

* WHERE...Los Olmos Creek near Falfurrias.

* WHEN...Until Friday morning.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 12:15 PM CST Thursday the stage was 6.85 feet and falling.
- Bankfull stage is 5.0 feet.
- The level has fallen from 8.7 feet at 5 PM Wednesday to below 7
feet just before noon Thursday.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall to 2.1 feet early
Tuesday afternoon, November 17th.
- Action stage is 5.0 feet.
- Flood stage is 11.0 feet.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

Stay tuned to further developments by listening to your local radio,
television, or NOAA Weather Radio for further information.

Additional information is available at www.water.noaa.gov.

The next statement will be issued late tonight at 130 AM CST.

properties.title: Flood Advisory issued November 12 at 9:40AM PST until November 13 at 4:00PM PST by NWS Sacramento CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Coastal Flooding from abnormally high tides.

* WHERE...Low-lying areas along the San Pablo Bay, Carquinez Strait,
and Suisun Bay shorelines in Solano County.

* WHEN...Until 400 PM PST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of low-lying areas including parks, lots,
roads, marshes, and vulnerable islands. Erosion along levees is
possible.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 937 AM PST, NWS meteorologists have determined that
abnormally high tides will result in Coastal Flooding.
- The highest tides forecast each day are (all times local
time):
* Port Chicago: 1.2 ft above normal (6.1 ft MLLW) at 2:15 PM
Thu 11/12, 1.0 ft above normal (5.9 ft MLLW) at 2:56 PM Fri
11/13, 0.7 ft above normal (5.6 ft MLLW) at 3:44 PM Sat
11/14, and 0.3 ft above normal (5.2 ft MLLW) at 4:39 PM Sun
11/15.
* West Sacramento: 1.2 ft above normal (5.5 ft MLLW) at 5:28
PM Thu 11/12, 1.0 ft above normal (5.4 ft MLLW) at 6:10 PM
Fri 11/13, 0.9 ft above normal (5.2 ft MLLW) at 6:57 PM Sat
11/14, and 0.6 ft above normal (5.0 ft MLLW) at 7:50 PM Sun
11/15.
* Rio Vista (Datum NAVD88): +7.5 ft at 5:00 PM Thu 11/12,
+7.7 ft at 5:00 PM Fri 11/13, and +7.6 ft at 6:00 PM Sat
11/14.
- These predictions include up to +1.1 feet of storm surge that
will enhance the astronomical tide and flooding threat.
Timing of high tide may vary up to an hour throughout the San
Francisco Bay and Delta.
- Real-time water levels and latest forecasts are available at:
* Port Chicago: https://tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/noaatidepre
dictions.html?id=9415144
* West Sacramento: https://tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/noaatide
predictions.html?id=9416131
* Rio Vista: https://water.noaa.gov/gauges/RVBC1
properties.instruction:
Some roads that are commonly dry may become inundated during high
tide. If you encounter flooded roadways: turn around, dont drown.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued November 12 at 8:06AM EST by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...

St Johns River Near Astor affecting Volusia and Lake Counties.

.Heavy rainfall that has occurred upstream has resulted in continued
river levels in Minor Flood Stage. River levels are expected to
remain steady into the weekend as a large volume of water works
northward through the basin, though developing northerly winds could
generate a small rise.

For the St. Johns River...including Astor...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...St Johns River near Astor.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 2.8 feet, Docks and boat ramps covered at South Moon
Fish Camp and approaching sea wall at Blair's Jungle Den. Water
approaching sites closest to the river at Fish Tales RV Resort and
Astor Landing Campground. Portion of Clair Street covered by river
water south of the Butler Boat Ramp. Docks underwater at the Astor
Bridge Marina and along Riveredge Drive. Portions of Fox Road are
covered with water nearest to the river. Acorn, Hazelnut and Redbud
roads are underwater with yards inundated.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 7:30 AM EST Thursday the stage was 2.7 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 2.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 7:30 AM EST Thursday was 2.8 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to remain steady above flood
stage at 2.7 to 2.8 feet.
- Flood stage is 2.3 feet.
